description: Send bots into Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls to record and transcribe them, from Recall.ai.
demo_scope: Hand-trimmed to a 7-command hero flow (bots create/list/get/leave/transcript, recordings list, auth status) for an outreach demo. The generator's full scaffold (offline sync/search, teach/recall self-learning loop, MCP server) was removed as out of scope; see README Known Gaps.
